'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2020–21 Australian bushfire season]]
**A bushfire on [[Fraser Island]], a [[UNESCO]] World Heritage Site off the coast of [[Queensland]], has burned across half the island and may irreversibly damage its unique ecosystem. Extinguishment has been ruled unlikely. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2020/dec/01/catastrophic-bushfire-on-queenslands-fraser-island-threatens-ecological-disaster (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Arecibo Observatory]]
**The [[Arecibo Observatory]]'s [[Arecibo Telescope|telescope]] receiver collapses into the reflector dish, according to the [[National Science Foundation]]. The [[radio telescope]] was due to be decommissioned and dismantled after support cables broke on August 10, 2020. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/01/arecibo-radio-telescope-collapses-puerto-rico (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Semeru]], the highest mountain on the [[Indonesia]]n [[list of islands of Indonesia|island]] of [[Java]], [[types of volcanic eruptions|erupts]]. [https://news.detik.com/berita-jawa-timur/d-5276405/gunung-semeru-meletus (detikNews)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
*****[[Florida]] surpasses one million cases, becoming the third state to do so after [[California]] and [[Texas]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/florida-becomes-third-state-surpass-1-million-coronavirus-cases-1551231 (''Newsweek'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mississippi]]
*****[[Governor of Mississippi|Mississippi Governor]] [[Tate Reeves]] issues a [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] for 13 additional counties in the [[Mississippi|state]] in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://apnews.com/article/mississippi-tate-reeves-coronavirus-pandemic-a07252489bff8669262620675fc0ee23 (AP)] 
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oregon]]
*****[[Oregon]] reports 24 new deaths in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://www.kezi.com/content/news/Oregon-reports-most-deaths-in-a-single-day-573255261.html (KEZI-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]]
*****[[Texas]] reports 15,182 new cases in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://www.dallasnews.com/news/public-health/2020/12/01/dallas-county-reports-8-deaths-1179-more-coronavirus-cases-tarrant-adds-1401-cases-6-deaths/ (''The Dallas Morning News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Toronto]]
******[[Toronto]] reports 761 cases, a new single-day record in the city. [https://www.thestar.com/politics/provincial/2020/12/01/ontarios-number-of-covid-19-patients-in-icus-climbs-as-toronto-reports-a-record-791-new-cases.html (''Toronto Star'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Yukon]]
*****[[Yukon]] officials announce a [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask mandate]] and urge people to stay at home amid an increase in cases. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/north/yukon-officials-covid-19-update-1.5822703 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Jakarta]] [[Governor of Jakarta|Governor]] [[Anies Baswedan]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]], a day after vice-governor [[Ahmad Riza Patria]] tests positive. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/jakarta-governor-anies-baswedan-tests-positive-for-covid-19 (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine]]
****[[Hamas]] [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] chief [[Yahya Sinwar]] tests positive for COVID-19. A spokesman for the group says he is "following the advice of health authorities and taking precautionary measures". [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-gaza-hamas/hamas-gaza-chief-tests-positive-for-covid-19-spokesman-says-idUSKBN28B4V3?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record 190 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the national death toll to 13,936. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/turkey-reports-30-100-new-covid-19-cases/2062190 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Queensland]] reopens its land border with [[Greater Sydney]] and [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]]. Travellers from both areas will now be allowed into the [[states and territories of Australia|state]] without needing to [[quarantine]]. [https://7news.com.au/travel/queensland-border-reopening-sees-travellers-from-victoria-and-sydney-welcomed--c-1681331 (7 News)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Pfizer]] and [[BioNTech]] announce that they will ask the [[European Medicines Agency]] to approve their [[BNT162b2|potential vaccine]] candidate. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/Business/wireStory/biontech-pfizer-europe-vaccine-emergency-74475977 (ABC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–United States relations]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] says that the [[Canada|country]] will not reopen their borders with the [[United States]] until COVID-19 is significantly under control. [https://www.sfgate.com/news/article/Canada-US-border-measures-to-last-until-virus-15766567.php (''San Francisco Chronicle'')]
*[[ASEAN–European Union relations]]
**The [[European Union]] and the [[ASEAN]] form a [[strategic partnership]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-europe-asean-partnership/european-union-and-asean-to-form-strategic-partnership-germany-idUKKBN28B4U0 (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 Trier attack]]
**Five people are killed and 18 others injured in [[Trier]], [[Rhineland-Palatinate]], [[Germany]], when a man drives an [[SUV]] into a [[pedestrian zone]]. The driver, a 51-year-old male German national, was arrested and was reportedly [[driving under the influence|drunk at the time]] of the crash. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55148518 (BBC News)]
*A group of gunmen attack a bank and block roads in [[Cametá]], [[Brazil]], taking several hostages and stealing money. The attackers kill a hostage with a gunshot to the head, while a security guard and a [[law enforcement in Brazil|policeman]] are injured. Several shots and explosions were also reported. It appears that the target of the attack was a branch of [[Banco do Brasil]], the same bank robbed in [[Criciúma]] the previous night. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-55155377 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Papua conflict]]
**The [[United Liberation Movement for West Papua]] declares a provisional "government-in-waiting" and nominates [[Benny Wenda]] as [[interim president]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/01/west-papua-independence-leaders-declare-government-in-waiting (''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2020 SO]]
**Unknown astronomical object [[2020 SO]] makes its closest approach to [[Earth]] at a perigee distance of approximately 0.13 [[Lunar distance (astronomy)|lunar distances]] (50,000 km; 31,000 mi). Researchers, who discovered 2020 SO on September 17, 2020, are still unsure whether the object is a small [[near-Earth asteroid]] or an artificial object. The booster of [[Surveyor 2]]'s [[Atlas-Centaur]] rocket, launched by [[NASA]] in 1966, is suspected by the [[Jet Propulsion Laboratory]]. [https://www.cnet.com/how-to/how-to-watch-a-mysterious-object-that-might-be-space-junk-fly-near-earth-today/ (CNET)]
*[[Chang'e 5]], [[Chinese Lunar Exploration Program]]
**[[China National Space Administration]] probe [[Chang'e 5]] successfully lands at [[Mons Rümker]] on the [[Moon]] for the first lunar [[sample-return mission]] since the [[Soviet Union]]'s [[Luna 24]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/01/science/china-moon-landing.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-55148998 (BBC News)]
